question: Which country won the most medals at the 2025 World Athletics Championships?
solution:
The correct answer is __**USA**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **20th edition** of the **World Athletics Championships** is scheduled to be held in **2025**.
 
• The **United States of America (USA)** is historically the most dominant nation in track and field, consistently topping the medal table in almost every iteration of the event.
 
• The **2025 Championships** are set to take place in **Tokyo, Japan**. The events will primarily be hosted at the **Japan National Stadium**, which was also the centerpiece for the **Tokyo 2020 Olympic Games**.
 
• The scheduled dates for this global sporting event are from **September 13 to September 21, 2025**.
